caption.SceneDescription: The scene depicts a lush, green grassy hillside bathed in bright sunlight, likely during the early morning or late afternoon given the long shadows cast by the trees. Several large, mature trees with full canopies stand prominently on the right side of the frame, their leaves a mix of green and hints of autumn colors. The grass is vibrant and well-maintained, covering the sloping terrain. In the background, a line of trees marks the horizon, adding depth to the landscape. The sky is clear with a few scattered clouds, and the overall atmosphere is peaceful and tranquil, evoking a sense of calm and natural beauty. The camera slowly tracks forward across the grassy slope, moving towards the trees.

editmeta.edit_instruction_1: Transform the vibrant green grassy hillside and the surrounding trees into a serene winter scene by gradually covering the ground with a thick, uniform layer of white snow that obscures the grass and creates a smooth, pristine surface, while simultaneously dusting the branches of the foreground and background trees with heavy white snow accumulation under soft, diffused lighting.
editmeta.edit_instruction_2: Add a giant red hot-air balloon descending above the snow-covered hillside and hovering beside the large trees, with saturated fabric and a dark wicker basket contrasting against the white ground and frosted branches.
editmeta.edit_instruction_3: Melt the thick snow from the hillside and tree branches and replace it with restored green grass covered in dense purple crocuses, while keeping the existing red hot-air balloon hovering above the spring landscape.
